name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and runs Nginx as a multi-site static web server for three HTTPS-enabled virtual hosts, with per-site document roots, generated development certificates, security headers, rate limiting, Fail2ban, firewall rules, and host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and a Fedora-specific compatibility adjustment for generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs the Python and PostgreSQL runtime for a FastAPI tutorial application, deploys the application from GitHub, creates its database and virtual environment, and manages its systemd/Uvicorn service.
